messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] latency-slo: p95 spikes in us-west -> automated routing adjustment triggered (policy: latency-driven fallback). Paging oncall: @alex 

alex: on it. getting dashboards up. which customer(s) are affected?

maria: I see many short-lived reroutes from us-west to us-east and eu-west starting ~1719203000. p95 crossed 800ms for model-xl across multiple routes. seems the controller is flip-flopping routing decisions every ~30s.

chris: product heads up: we have some enterprise customers on us-west pinned to model-xl. high latency there causes fallback to quantized variants in other regions which then get overloaded and increase latency — cascade.

alex: ok first mitigation: can we disable latency-driven fallback policy for 2 regions (us-east + eu-west) to stop automatic cross-region moves? 

maria: I can disable the policy flag on controller (rollout id: r-7642). Doing it now. 

maria: done — policy "latency-fallback" set = false in controller. Observability: starting to see fewer reroute events.

jamie: support: customers reporting degraded conversational latency but not errors. support ticket 45321 is asking for ETA. I'll notify them it's being mitigated.

alex: next: pin critical customers in us-west to the non-quant model variant (model-xl-v2) to avoid automatic variant fallback. Maria can we apply pinning via runtime config?

maria: yes, pushing route override for the tenant set: 
```
PATCH /routing/overrides
{
  "selector": "tenant in (acme, brightdrop)",
  "override": {"model_variant": "model-xl-v2", "region": "us-west"}
}
```
Applied. Please monitor token throughput—we may saturate dedicated pool.

alex: good. Nina, can you scale up us-west dedicated pool by +1 node and hold autoscaler disabled for the next 20m?

nina-bot: Scaling request received. Spinning up 1 g4 node in us-west. Autoscaling paused for group redwood-dedicated-usw for 20m.

chris: also let's add a 60s hysteresis to the controller so short p95 blips don't immediately trigger reroutes. Maria can you update controller config?

maria: adding controller hysteresis=60s and min-sample-window=2m now. Restarting controller process on canary.

incident-bot: controller canary restart complete for canary-3. Observability links: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/latency-routing?orgId=1

alex: monitoring. If p95 stays stable <700ms for next 5m we'll keep flags. If not, fallback to manual failover.

jamie: support updated tickets: "We are seeing elevated latency; engineering is mitigating and will update in 30m." :thumbsup:

nina-bot: us-west node added and healthy. CPU ~65%, GPU util ~38%. Routing table shows pinned tenants on model-xl-v2.

maria: after hysteresis change reroute count dropped from ~120/min to ~3/min. p95 trending down to ~520ms for affected routes.

alex: great. I'll keep paging channel open for 30m then start handoff to follow-the-sun oncall. Chris — can you draft a quick customer-impact blurb for our status page? Keep it conservative.

chris: drafting now. TL;DR: "We observed elevated request latency in us-west starting at 12:10 UTC due to cascading cross-region routing changes. Automatic mitigations have been applied; most customers are seeing improvements. We are continuing monitoring and will post a full incident summary after root cause analysis."

jamie: forwarded blurb to customers on affected tickets.

tess: quick note from infra — controller logs show a backpressure signal from the kv-cache metrics channel around 1719202900, which may have driven the initial p95 bump. Will add to RCA scope.

alex: action items for post-incident: 
- collect controller and routing decisions timeline (maria)
- KV-cache and model-serving queue metrics (infra/tess)
- validate model variant perf regression (chris/research)
- customer impact timeline and comms (jamie/chris)
- config change audit and revert plan (alex)

maria: capturing and exporting logs to /incidents/1719203579/export.tar.gz.

alex: I'm going to hand off after 30m to Pat (follow-the-sun). If anything spikes, re-page immediately. Otherwise we declare mitigated and start RCA later.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled: alex -> pat at 1719205323. Paging channel will remain pinned.

chris: thanks team. I'll coordinate the RCA doc and include workload repro steps for research.

jamie: closing customer loop for now, will reopen if they report new issues.

alex: marking incident as mitigated for now. will post postmortem once we have full logs. :white_check_mark:
